sources.title: Use connectors to extend Claude's capabilities
Get started with custom connectors using remote MCP

folds.title: Connectors
points: A **connector** lets Claude reach your apps and services.
It can find your data and take actions there.
Like searching your files or sending a message.

folds.title: MCP
points: **MCP**, the Model Context Protocol, is an open standard created by Anthropic.
It lets AI apps connect to tools and data.
Think of it as a shared plug shape.

folds.title: Connect one
items: Browse the connectors directory from a chat or from Customize.
Switch it on in a chat from the plus menu.

folds.title: What Claude can see
points: Claude inherits your permissions in each service.
So it cannot see what you could not.
But connecting lets it read, and possibly change, your data there.

folds.title: A connector at work

chat.you: Find my notes from last week's meeting with Sam.

chat.claude: I searched your connected files and found two documents from that meeting. Here is a short summary.

folds.note: Claude reaches only what you could reach yourself.

folds.title: Stay safe
points: Only connect services you trust and need.
Read the permissions at sign-in and turn off tools you do not need.
Disconnect services you no longer use.
A **custom connector** uses a remote MCP server that Anthropic does not verify. Pick trusted ones.

folds.question: A tool asks for permission to change data in a service you barely use. What is the safest choice?
options: Deny it, or turn that tool off
Connect it and hope for the best
folds.why: Only connect what you trust and need, and be careful with tools that write or change things.
